 created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        program_id=row[\"program_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        topic=row[\"topic\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_post_by_id(post_id: int) -> Post | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_posts_by_program(program_id: int) -> list[Post]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM posts WHERE program_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC\",\n            (program_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef is_program_page(page: Page) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A Program is the Page three levels below Home (Home -> Continent ->\n    Country -> Program), per CONTEXT.md and the spec's Post.program_id field.\"\"\"\n    return len(list_ancestors(page)) == 3\n\n\ndef create_post(program_id: int, title: str, body: str, topic: str, author_id: int) -> Post:\n    program = get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"program page {program_id} does not exist\")\n    if not is_program_page(program):\n        raise ValueError(f\"page {program_id} is not a Program-level page\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n    sibling_slugs = {p.slug for p in list_posts_by_program(program_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, author_id) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_post_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_post(post_id: int, title: str, body: str, topic: str) -> Post:\n    post = get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"post {post_id} does not exist\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n    if post.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            p.slug for p in list_posts_by_program(post.program_id) if p.id != post.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = post.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, topic = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, topic, post_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_post(post_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","numLines":418,"startLine":1,"totalLines":418}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3b890d2d-9dd5-462d-a5d3-f571b6f302e9","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"729dd839-b9ac-496b-9148-4429c5f0a5d2","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} draft posts across Topics under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","numLines":128,"startLine":1,"totalLines":128}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"11239836-6df4-417f-aaff-c16c13ed8bd7","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"729dd839-b9ac-496b-9148-4429c5f0a5d2","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

FastAPI application.\n\nT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\nanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, pages, posts, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import (\n    AdminRequired,\n    CsrfInvalid,\n    LoginRequired,\n    ensure_csrf_token,\n    get_current_user,\n)\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n","numLines":71,"startLine":1,"totalLines":71}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"77e59d36-52c3-49c2-a8db-a491f04a304a","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"729dd839-b9ac-496b-9148-4429c5f0a5d2","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

`csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": {"parentUuid":"4f0b8423-993c-44c8-949b-b12d1efccfa1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"d0dcc7bf-7e28-48b9-b7ba-8002ea691b6a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Qp86RvQtF7hRi1Bw48RShS","type":"tool_result","content":"T04---\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Check your submission before you send it. The judge runs this first.\n\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2 --json\n\nStage 0 is the instructor's check of the template itself.\nExit code 0 means every check passed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSECRET = re.compile(r\"(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S{8,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY)\")\nREPORT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nTRANSCRIPT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_\\d{2}_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nSCREENS = [\"login\", \"dashboard\", \"content-list\", \"editor\", \"users\", \"editor-denied\"]\n\n\ndef sh(*args: str) -> str:\n    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\n\n\nclass Checks:\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.results: list[dict] = []\n\n    def add(self, ok: bool, name: str, detail: str, fix: str = \"\") -> None:\n        self.results.append({\"check\": name, \"ok\": bool(ok), \"detail\": detail, \"fix\": fix})\n\n    # --- checks -----------------------------------------------------------\n    def hygiene(self) -> None:\n        tracked = sh(\"git\", \"ls-files\").splitlines()\n        bad = [f for f in tracked if f.endswith((\".db\", \".env\")) or f.startswith(\".claude/state/\")]\n        self.add(not bad, \"no database or .env committed\", \", \".join(bad) or \"clean\",\n                 \"git rm --cached <file>, confirm .gitignore covers it, then rewrite history if it is old\")\n        history = sh(\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"-p\", \"--\", \".\")\n        hits = sorted(set(SECRET.findall(history)))\n        self.add(not hits, \"no secrets in history\", f\"{len(hits)} match(es)\",\n                 \"rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history\")\n        self.add((ROOT / \".env.example\").exists(), \".env.example present\", \"\", \"restore it from the template\")\n\n    def docs(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        pairs = [\n            (\"notes/cms-field-notes.md\", \"field notes\"),\n            (\"CONTEXT.md\", \"glossary\"),\n            (\"notes/token-budget-plan.md\", \"token budget plan\"),\n            (\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\", \"usage ledger\"),\n            (\"docs/process/compaction-log.md\", \"compaction log\"),\n        ]\n        if stage >= 2:\n            pairs += [(\"README.md\", \"README\"), (\"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \"seed script\")]\n        for path, label in pairs:\n            self.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"{label} present\", path, f\"create {path}\")\n        if stage >= 2:\n            handoffs = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"handoff\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n            self.add(bool(handoffs), \"at least one handoff saved\", f\"{len(handoffs)} file(s)\",\n                     \"copy a /handoff document into docs/handoff/\")\n\n    def naming(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        reports = list((ROOT / \"docs\").glob(\"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_*.md\"))\n        if stage >= 2:\n            ok = any(REPORT.match(p.name) for p in reports)\n            self.add(ok, \"report named correctly\",\n                     \", \".join(p.name for p in reports) or \"missing\",\n                     \"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, lowercase\")\n        transcripts = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n        bad = [p.name for p in transcripts if not TRANSCRIPT.match(p.name)]\n        self.add(transcripts and not bad, \"transcripts present and named correctly\",\n                 f\"{len(transcripts)} file(s); bad: {bad or 'none'}\",\n                 \"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{NN}_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md\")\n\n    def readme(self, stage: int) -> None:\n---issue-tracker---\n# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n\n## Conventions\n\n- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.\n\n## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n\nRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n\n## Wayfinding operations\n\nUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n\n- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Every cell of the spec's status/action table, including the\ndisallowed ones, lives here so app/routes/posts.py only has to call\n`transition()` and turn a ValueError into a 403.\n\n| From      | Action    | Who                        | To        |\n|-----------|-----------|-----------------------------|-----------|\n| draft     | submit    | the Post's own author       | pending   |\n| pending   | publish   | any admin                   | published |\n| pending   | bounce    | any admin                   | draft     |\n| draft     | publish   | admin, own Post only        | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin                   | draft     |\n\nNo other (status, action) pair exists.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\n_Rule = Callable[[str, bool], bool]\n\n_RULES: dict[tuple[str, str], _Rule] = {\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): lambda role, is_author: is_author,\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\" and is_author,\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n}\n\n_TARGETS: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): \"pending\",\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): \"draft\",\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): \"draft\",\n}\n\nACTION_LABELS = {\n    \"submit\": \"Submit for review\",\n    \"publish\": \"Publish\",\n    \"bounce\": \"Bounce to draft\",\n    \"unpublish\": \"Unpublish\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(status: str, action: str, role: str, is_author: bool) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the Post's new status.\n\n    Raises ValueError if `action` isn't allowed from `status` for this\n    role/authorship combination — including an admin trying to take someone\n    else's draft straight to published, which must pass through pending\n    first same as anyone's.\n    \"\"\"\n    key = (status, action)\n    rule = _RULES.get(key)\n    if rule is None or not rule(role, is_author):\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"{action!r} is not allowed on a {status!r} post \"\n            f\"(role={role!r}, is_author={is_author!r})\"\n        )\n to decide which buttons to render in the Posts list.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        action\n        for (st, action), rule in _RULES.items()\n        if st == status and rule(role, is_author)\n    ]\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":279,"cache_read_input_tokens":94568,"output_tokens":1137,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":279,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1137,"cache_read_input_tokens":94568,"cache_creation_input_tokens":279,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":279},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01UFPNm3yqXnED1JGKzyfzFf":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/review_gate.py","content":"\"\"\"The This is every cell of the spec's table,\n# including every disallowed combination.\nCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status,action,role,is_author,expected\", CASES)\ndef test_transition_table(status, action, role, is_author, expected):\n    if expected is None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n    else:\n        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", STATUSES)\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"is_author\", [True, False])\ndef test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n    allowed = review_gate.available_actions(status, role, is_author)\n    for action in ACTIONS:\n        case = next(\n            c for c in CASES\n            if c[0] == status and c[1] == action and c[2] == role and c[3] == is_author\n        )\n        expected_target = case[4]\n        if expected_target is None:\n            assert action not in allowed\n        else:\n            assert action in allowed\n            assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected_target\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam: the routes wire the above into the Posts admin screens -----\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_draft_post(c, program_id: int, title: str = \"My First Week\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello\",\n              \"topic\": \"housing\", \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_submits_own_draft_then_loses_edit_access(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(c, program.id)\n\n    list_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    # Locked out of editing now that it's pending.\n    assert c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\").status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_staff_publishes_or_bounces_a_pending_post_from_anyone(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(editor_c, program.id)\n    token = models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/bounce\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n    # Resubmit, then publish this time.\n    token = _csrf_token_from(editor_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    editor_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_self_publishes_own_draft_directly(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(admin_c, program.id)\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_unpublishes_a_live_post(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(admin_c, program.id)\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/unpublish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_push_someone_elses_draft_straight_to_published(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(editor_c, program.id)\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_rejected_for_any_transition_other_than_submitting_own_draft(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    owner = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(owner, program.id)\n\n    other = models.create_user(\n        email=\"other-editor@example.test\", password=\"test-other-pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Other Ambassador\",\n    )\n    intruder = client_as(\"editor\")\n    login_page = intruder.get(\"/login\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(login_page.text)\n    intruder.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": other.email, \"password\": \"test-other-pw\",\n                                   \"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(owner.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/bounce\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/unpublish\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_seeds_posts_in_all_three_statuses(client):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    all_posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n    assert len(all_posts) == len(programs)\n    assert {p.status for p in all_posts} == {\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"}\n    assert len({p.topic for p in all_posts}) > This is every cell of the spec's table,\n# including every disallowed combination.\nCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status,action,role,is_author,expected\", CASES)\ndef test_transition_table(status, action, role, is_author, expected):\n    if expected is None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n    else:\n        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", STATUSES)\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"is_author\", [True, False])\ndef test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n    allowed = review_gate.available_actions(status, role, is_author)\n    for action in ACTIONS:\n        case = next(\n            c for c in CASES\n            if c[0] == status and c[1] == action and c[2] == role and c[3] == is_author\n        )\n        expected_target = case[4]\n        if expected_target is None:\n            assert action not in allowed\n        else:\n            assert action in allowed\n            assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected_target\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam: the routes wire the above into the Posts admin screens -----\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_draft_post(c, program_id: int, title: str = \"My First Week\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello\",\n              \"topic\": \"housing\", \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_submits_own_draft_then_loses_edit_access(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(c, program.id)\n\n    list_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    # Locked out of editing now that it's pending.\n    assert c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\").status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_staff_publishes_or_bounces_a_pending_post_from_anyone(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(editor_c, program.id)\n    token = _csrf_token_from(editor_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    editor_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/bounce\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n    # Resubmit, then publish this time.\n    token = _csrf_token_from(editor_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    editor_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_self_publishes_own_draft_directly(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(admin_c, program.id)\n\n    token = token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_unpublishes_a_live_post(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(admin_c, program.id)\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/unpublish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_push_someone_elses_draft_straight_to_published(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Home -> Continent -> Country -> Program, matching the spec's\n    \"Program is three levels below Home\" field definition.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id, title, body=\"Hello **world**\", topic=\"housing\"):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    return c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": body,\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_editor_creates_edits_deletes_own_draft_post(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    response = _create_post(c, program.id, \"My First Week\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    assert post.title == \"My First Week\"\n    assert post.slug == \"my-first-week\"\n    assert post.topic == \"housing\"\n    assert post.status == \"draft\"\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    assert post.author_id == editor.id\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    assert edit_page.status_code == 200\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Post\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"meals\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    renamed = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert renamed.title == \"Renamed Post\"\n    assert renamed.slug == \"renamed-post\"\n    assert renamed.topic == \"meals\"\n\n    confirm = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\")\n    assert confirm.status_code == 200\n    assert \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code malicious = 'Hi <script>alert(1)</script> <img src=x onerror=\"alert(2)\">'\n    response = c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"Draft\", assert post.slug == \"first-title\"\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Title\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).slug == conn = db.get_connection()\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = ?\", (post.id,))\n    conn.commit()\n    conn.close()\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Title The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate","originalFile":"\"\"\"Post authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, and a sanitized Markdown preview.\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. Submitting for review,\npublishing, bouncing, and unpublishing are T04 (#5), not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts\": posts, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts\": posts, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _authorize_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delegate the allow/deny decision for a status transition to the\n    review-gate service; a rejection becomes a 403, same as post writes.\"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts\": posts, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _authorize_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delegate the allow/deny decision for a status transition to the\n    review-gate service; a rejection becomes a 403, same as post writes.\"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions,\n         \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return
