(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"ebaafc5d-0b1f-4262-97d2-3c8fea191c87","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:05:24.155Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py","oldString":"# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]","newString":"# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} draft posts across Topics under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":92,"oldLines":12,"newStart":92,"newLines":18,"lines":[" ","     for i, program in enumerate(programs):","         topic = POST_TOPICS[i % The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>All tests pass. Given the strength of the test coverage (53 passing tests covering every cell of the state-machine table), the implementation correctly matches ADR-004 and the T04 ticket's acceptance criteria. My remaining findings are edge cases the test suite doesn't exercise (concurrency) and design/cleanup observations.\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/models.py\",\n    \"line\": 411,\n    \"summary\": \"_set_post_status() issues an unconditional UPDATE by id with no WHERE status = &lt;expected-current-status&gt; guard, so the status transition validated in app/routes/posts.py's _authorize_transition() is not re-checked atomically at write time.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Two admins act on the same pending Post concurrently: one bounces it to draft while another (racing) request, having already read status='pending' before the first write committed, calls publish_post(). Both validations pass against the stale 'pending' read, and the second write silently stomps the first, landing the Post on 'published' immediately after being bounced back to draft for more edits — bypassing the review-gate invariant the whole module exists to enforce.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/models.py\",\n    \"line\": 411,\n    \"summary\": \"The target status for each transition (submit→pending, publish→published, bounce→draft, unpublish→draft) is hardcoded again in models.py's four wrapper functions, duplicating app/services/review_gate.py's _TARGETS table instead of calling review_gate.transition() and using its returned value.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A future change to the state machine (e.g. adding a new status or redirecting bounce to a different target) is made only in review_gate._TARGETS; app/routes/posts.py still calls the old models.bounce_post()/etc., which writes the old hardcoded status, so validation (review_gate) and execution (models) silently disagree and the service-layer unit tests (which only exercise review_gate directly) don't catch it.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/models.py\",\n    \"line\": 448,\n    \"summary\": \"unpublish_post() resets status to 'draft' but does not clear published_at, leaving a stale timestamp from the prior publish on a Post that is no longer published.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A Post is published (published_at set), later unpublished back to draft, and then re-submitted/edited; any future admin UI or report that reads published_at to show 'first/last published' or to decide whether a draft was ever live will see a non-null published_at on a Post currently sitting in draft, which can misrepresent its history alongside the status column.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"scripts/seed_demo.py\",\n    \"line\": 102,\n    \"summary\": \"The result of models.submit_post(post.id) is assigned back to `post` but never used afterward (publish_post(post.id) is called with the original id, not the returned object), making the reassignment dead code.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"No functional break today, but it reads as if `post` is needed downstream (e.g. for logging or a subsequent field read) when it isn't, making future edits to this loop more error-prone to review.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>78019</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>27</tool_uses><duration_ms>550745</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

AND status = ?\",\n            (to_status, post_id, from_status),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise StatusConflict(\n                f\"post {post_id} The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _authorize_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delegate the allow/deny decision for a status transition to the\n    review-gate service; a rejection becomes a 403, same as post writes.\"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions,\n         \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions,\n         \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"6238bd84-44b1-45e7-a750-460f74c1da47","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:15:46.918Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py","oldString":"        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            post = models.submit_post(post.id)\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.publish_post(post.id)","newString":"        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            post = models.submit_post(post.id)\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.publish_post(post.id)\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts across Topics and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":99,"oldLines":9,"newStart":99,"newLines":9,"lines":["             topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,","         )","         if status in \"published\":","-            models.publish_post(post.id)","+            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")","     print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts {"parentUuid":"f7e1ff8a-cd61-453b-ba4a-86eb9946d2fe","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfjnRSJi4tisFhjvk6R2w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Nk6C7CCtvbpdxACTuFGmG7","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 5 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review high — findings and resolutions\n\n1. **Race condition on status writes** (`app/models.py`) — the original `submit_post`/`publish_post`/`bounce_post`/`unpublish_post` wrote status unconditionally by id, so the review-gate authorization check (read-then-decide in the route) wasn't re-verified atomically at write time. Two admins racing on the same pending Post could have one writer silently clobber the other's transition.\n   **Fixed**: collapsed the four writers into one `models.set_post_status(post_id, from_status, to_status)` that guards the UPDATE with `WHERE status = from_status` and raises `StatusConflict` (-> HTTP 409) if the row didn't match, i.e. another request changed it first.\n\n2. **Duplicated transition targets** — `models.py`'s wrapper functions hardcoded the same from/to status pairs already defined in `app/services/review_gate.py`'s `_TARGETS` table, so the two could silently drift.\n   **Fixed**: routes now take the `to_status` straight from `review_gate.transition()`'s return value and pass it into `set_post_status`; there's only one place the target status is decided.\n\n3. **Stale `published_at` after unpublish** — unpublishing reset status to draft but left the old `published_at` timestamp in place.\n   **Fixed**: `set_post_status` sets `published_at` on entry to `published` and clears it on any exit from it.\n\n4. **Dead reassignment in `scripts/seed_demo.py`** — `post = models.submit_post(post.id)` assigned a value never used afterward.\n   **Fixed**: removed along with the broader `set_post_status` refactor above.\n\nAdded `tests/test_t04.py::test_set_post_status_rejects_a_stale_from_status` and `::test_unpublish_clears_published_at` to cover the conflict guard and the `published_at` lifecycle. {"type":"queue-operation","operation":"enqueue","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:26:00.933Z","sessionId":"729dd839-b9ac-496b-9148-4429c5f0a5d2","content":"# Autonomous loop check\n\nYou're being invoked on a timer while the user is away or occupied. The point is to keep work moving forward without the user driving every step - finishing things they started, maintaining PRs they're building, catching problems before they come back to find them. You're a steward, not an initiator. The user set you loose on their work, and the value you provide comes from reliably advancing things they've already set in motion, not from finding new things to do.\n\nThe key tension to navigate: the user trusts you enough to run autonomously, but that trust is easily lost. Acting on what the conversation already established is safe and valuable. Inventing new work or making irreversible changes without clear authorization erodes trust fast. When you're unsure whether something falls into \"continuing established work\" or \"inventing new work,\" lean toward the former only when the transcript provides clear evidence the user wanted it done. If you find yourself reaching for justifications about why a push is probably fine, that's a signal to wait.\n\n## What to act on\n\nThe current conversation is your highest-signal source - re-read the transcript above, since everything there is something the user was actively engaged with. The strongest signal is an in-progress PR you've been building together: review comments to address and resolve, failing CI checks to diagnose (and re-enqueue if they're flakes), merge conflicts to fix. The goal is to get the PR into a state where it's ready to merge pending only human review - the user shouldn't come back to find a PR blocked on things you could have handled. After that, look for unfinished implementation where the last exchange left something half-done, and explicit \"I'll also...\" or \"next I'll...\" commitments the conversation made and didn't honor. Weaker but still real: dangling questions you could now answer, verification steps that were skipped, edge cases that were mentioned but not handled, and natural continuations that don't require new decisions.\n\nIf you find anything in this category, act on it - actually do the work, don't describe what could be done. Run the tests, don't say \"you could run the tests.\" The whole point of autonomous operation is that work gets done while the user is away.\n\nWhen the conversation transcript has nothing left, the current branch's pull/merge request on the user's SCM is the next-best place to look. This is maintenance work - valuable, but lower priority than continuing the user's active work. Find the PR/MR for the current branch via the SCM's CLI, then check three things: CI status, unresolved review threads, and whether the branch has fallen behind the base. For failing CI, pull the failing job's logs and diagnose before acting - flaky-shaped failures (timeout, runner died, transient network) can be re-enqueued; real failures need a reproduction and a minimal fix. For unresolved review threads, fetch the comment, address the feedback, push, and resolve the thread via, for example, the GitHub GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation (or the equivalent for whichever SCM the project uses). Before pushing anything, check whether someone else has pushed to the branch while you were working - if so, rebase (don't merge) to keep history clean.\n\nWhen CI is green, threads are clear, and there's idle time, sweeping the branch for issues is a good use of that time - bug-hunt or simplification passes catch problems before reviewers do, saving everyone a round-trip.\n\nIf everything is genuinely quiet - no conversation work, no PR maintenance - say so in one sentence and stop. No summary of what you checked, no list of what you might do later. The user will see your message in the transcript when they come back; three consecutive \"nothing to do\" results means you should scale back to a quick CI check and stop, not narrate.\n\n## Repeated invocations\n\nIf you see earlier autonomous checks in this conversation, adjust your scope accordingly. If a previous check left a question the user hasn't answered, the cost of acting depends on reversibility: for reversible actions (local edits, running tests), make your best call and proceed; for irreversible ones (pushing, deleting, sending), keep waiting - the cost of acting wrongly on something irreversible is much higher than the cost of waiting one more cycle. If three or more consecutive checks have found nothing actionable, things are quiet - do one quick CI/threads check and stop in a single line. Repeated \"nothing to do\" messages clutter the transcript and waste the user's attention when they come back to review.\n\nRead and analyze freely - understanding the state of things has no blast radius. Make edits and run tests when you're confident they continue established work. Commit and push only when you're clearly continuing something the user authorized, or when the work pattern makes the intent obvious - like fixing CI on a PR you've been building together.\n\n\n---\n\n# Autonomous loop tick (dynamic pacing)\n\nRun the autonomous check using the loop instructions established earlier in this conversation. {"parentUuid":"701f3ed4-ab00-474e-87c0-619ba356ffb1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4b88a029-1e34-41f1-9014-8e2d18bdbf7b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"<bash-stdout>author:\tadamleidercollege-code\nassociation:\towner\nedited:\tfalse\nstatus:\tnone\n--\n## /code-review high — findings and resolutions\n\n1. **Race condition on status writes** (`app/models.py`) — the original `submit_post`/`publish_post`/`bounce_post`/`unpublish_post` wrote status unconditionally by id, so the review-gate authorization check (read-then-decide in the route) wasn't re-verified atomically at write time. Two admins racing on the same pending Post could have one writer silently clobber the other's transition.\n   **Fixed**: collapsed the four writers into one `models.set_post_status(post_id, from_status, to_status)` that guards the UPDATE with `WHERE status = from_status` and raises `StatusConflict` (-&gt; HTTP 409) if the row didn't match, i.e. another request changed it first.\n\n2. **Duplicated transition targets** — `models.py`'s wrapper functions hardcoded the same from/to status pairs already defined in `app/services/review_gate.py`'s `_TARGETS` table, so the two could silently drift.\n   **Fixed**: routes now take the `to_status` straight from `review_gate.transition()`'s return value and pass it into `set_post_status`; there's only one place the target status is decided.\n\n3. **Stale `published_at` after unpublish** — unpublishing reset status to draft but left the old `published_at` timestamp in place.\n   **Fixed**: `set_post_status` sets `published_at` on entry to `published` and clears it on any exit from it.\n\n4. **Dead reassignment in `scripts/seed_demo.py`** — `post = models.submit_post(post.id)` assigned a value never used afterward.\n   **Fixed**: removed along with the broader `set_post_status` refactor above.\n\nAdded `tests/test_t04.py::test_set_post_status_rejects_a_stale_from_status` and `::test_unpublish_clears_published_at` to cover the conflict guard and the `published_at` lifecycle. Full suite: 103 passed.\n--</bash-stdout><bash-stderr></bash-stderr>"},"uuid":"9cb1ce69-422d-4f7d-8b2a-47284ea82b59","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:34:37.866Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"729dd839-b9ac-496b-9148-4429c5f0a5d2","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

It is prepended to every turn, so every line costs context\non every message. Add a rule only after you have had to correct the same thing\ntwice.\n\n## What this repo is\n\nA small web CMS for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2. A local admin console\n(FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite) writes content; `cms publish` renders the published\ncontent into `site/` as static HTML, which is deployed to GitHub Pages. The\nadmin console never goes on the public internet.\n\n## Hard constraints\n\n- Published HTML uses **relative** paths only. Never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`.\n- This applies to every template, admin included, not just `templates/public/`:\n  `scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked `.html` file for `href=\"/`\n  and `src=\"/`, so an absolute link in an admin template fails submission too.\n- Never commit `.env`, `*.db`, keys, or tokens. Read secrets from the environment.\n- Passwords are hashed with argon2. Never store or log a plain password.\n- Every state-changing form carries a CSRF token.\n- User-written Markdown is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere.\n- `site/` is generated. Never edit it by hand.\n- Only published content reaches `site/`. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n## How to work with me\n\n- One ticket per session. Read the ticket issue, the spec issue, and `CONTEXT.md`\n  before writing code.\n- Write the ticket id into `.claude/state/phase` when a stage starts\n  (`grill`, `spec`, `tickets`, or `T03`), so the usage ledger is labelled.\n- Use the vocabulary in `CONTEXT.md`. If a better word appears, update the\n  glossary rather than using both.\n- When `/status` shows a non-Anthropic base URL, add a `Backend: <provider> <model>`\n  trailer to every commit made in that session.\n- Before a commit that closes a ticket: post the `/code-review` findings, and how\n  each was resolved, as a comment on that issue. Then commit with a message that\n  starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n- Ask before adding a dependency. The stack in `pyproject.toml` is fixed for this\n  project.\n\n## Agent skills\n\n### Issue tracker\n\nIssues and specs live in this repo's GitHub Issues (`adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms`), via the `gh` CLI. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n\n### Domain docs\n\nSingle-context layout: `CONTEXT.md` + `docs/adr/` at the repo root.
